---
name: Protocol review
about: Raise a protocol, lifecycle, authority, or auditability question or concern
title: "[review] "
labels: review
---

## Summary

A clear, one or two sentence description of the review point.

## Area reviewed

- [ ] Authority model
- [ ] Queue lifecycle
- [ ] Clearance packet
- [ ] CLI / tooling
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security / privacy
- [ ] Other

## Concern or question

What is unclear, incorrect, or worth reconsidering?

## Proposed change

A specific suggestion, if you have one. Keep it scoped.

## Status, lane, or authority affected

Which status (for example `RTA`, `CTA`, `DTA`, `RFI_PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`,
`DONE`, `FAILED`, `SUPERSEDED`), which queue lane, or which authority class does
this touch?

## Examples or references

Generic examples or links to relevant docs. Keep examples generic.

## Out-of-scope confirmation

- [ ] No secrets
- [ ] No customer data
- [ ] No live clearance packet data
